name: Adelita Grijalva
stance: Supports international AI guardrails against uncontrollable frontier AI; original cosponsor of the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act.

statements.text: Signed the Ansari-led letter demanding the administration negotiate AI global-security rules to prevent the proliferation of uncontrollable frontier AI.
Original cosponsor of the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538).
